answer: Fresh and crisp apples are available in January, May, June, and September from local orchards.
Vine-ripened tomatoes are available in March, April, and December, ideal for salads and sauces.
Sweet farm strawberries are in season across multiple months (March, May, June, August, September, October, December).
Crunchy local carrots are harvested and available fresh around February and October.
Locally grown potatoes are available year-round at almost every farmers market.
Aromatic fresh basil is best found in May and July, perfect for homemade pesto and seasoning.
Refreshing mint leaves are picked in September, October, and November for teas and cocktails.
Nutrient-packed spinach leaves are available at their best in February and June.
Autumn pumpkins arrive from August through October, perfect for pies, soups, and roasting.
Fresh sweet corn is harvested in March and May, wonderful for grilling and summer cooking.
Fresh, wholesome milk from local dairy farms is supplied year-round across our partner markets.
Artisanal cheeses ranging from creamy brie to sharp cheddar are available year-round.
